title: Vulnerable Earth

vibeProfile.oneLine: How today's literature imagines the climate crisis, surveyed and mapped.

summary: In Vulnerable Earth: The Literature of Climate Crisis, Pramod K. Nayar surveys the global literature that has grown up around ecological catastrophe: literary fiction, graphic novels and memoirs of toxic waste and bondage. He groups the works by theme, from the fiction of water crisis to species extinction, rewilding, cross-species encounters, and stories that bind social justice to environmental justice. A wide-ranging, accessible work of criticism mapping how writers are imagining a damaged planet.
whyReadIt: Nayar maps how writers worldwide are imagining ecological catastrophe. A wide-ranging guide to the literature of climate crisis.

funFacts.text: Nayar holds a UNESCO Chair in Vulnerability Studies at the University of Hyderabad.
